name: Kashi & Co.
description: Where tradition meets innovation in every dish

reviews.text: The butter chicken was absolutely divine. The spices were perfectly balanced and the service was impeccable.
reviews.author: Sarah Mitchell

reviews.text: Finally, Indian food that feels contemporary without losing its soul. The ambiance is stunning and the biryani is a must-try.
reviews.author: James Chen

reviews.text: A sophisticated take on traditional flavors. The paneer tikka was tender and flavorful. Will definitely be returning.
reviews.author: Emily Rodriguez

reviews.text: The lamb rogan josh transported me back to Kashmir. Exceptional execution and beautiful presentation.
reviews.author: Michael Thompson

reviews.text: Perfect for a romantic dinner. The Goan fish curry was incredible, and the staff made us feel like family.
reviews.author: Priya Sharma
